nombre_oficial.texto: El Castillo and the Heart of the Plaza

frase_gancho.texto: A stone calendar between the sky and the underworld.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You are on the Gran Nivelación, an enormous artificial platform on which the city’s most famous buildings rise. In this area there are six stops around El Castillo, the temple of Kukulcán, the Feathered Serpent. You will see the pyramid and its play of shadows at the equinoxes, the older temple it holds inside, the Platform of Venus, and the Tzompantli, with its carved skulls. You will also see the Platform of the Eagles and Jaguars, where images of war and sacrifice are central to the story told here. What is known and what is debated go side by side at every stop.
